Anna goes to the supermarket on Tuesday. My friend Tom is very kind. I like my life very much. He started a small company last year.
We often go to the supermarket together. The school sports day is my favorite place. Tom likes soup too. Best of all, my composition about summer won first prize at school.
Tom often helps me with art. Anna wants to visit Toronto. I am happy every day.
